source.text: FIRST district: "What is your registered district?" Format text; trim spaces.

requirements.ask_text: In which year did you open your account?

source.text: SECOND opening_year: "In which year did you open your account?" Format year, exactly four digits.

requirements.ask_text: What is your five-digit service token?

source.text: THIRD token: "What is your five-digit service token?" Format digits, exactly five, retain leading zeros. Ask separately; verify each complete answer. No date question; no hint exception.

Two wrong answers TOTAL across all three questions. API tries_left authoritative. Exhaustion: "Please contact a Tessel branch." then 40/R40. Explicit refusal: explain account protection once, second refusal 40/R41. Questions about purpose are not refusals. get_account only after all three pass. | Two asks maximum; answer questions before repeat; then 50/R50 if unclear.
Callback ONLY next business day, 16:05 to 18:35 inclusive, strictly after now. Ask for missing time; one alternate after invalid offer. Scheduled: 50/R51; twice invalid or declined: 50/R52.
No account detail or security questions to relatives. Ask availability. ... Wrong number: 50/R53. Deceased: "Please accept our sympathy." then 50/R54; no further questions.
Monday through Saturday open; Sunday closed. Only holiday 2026-12-24. Next weekday means following calendar week; this weekday means current week. Missing month or year: ask.
Band I / days 1–5 | Deadline = today plus THREE CALENDAR days, adjusted preceding. ZERO persuasion attempts.
Band II / days 6–25 | Deadline = TWENTIETH of NEXT month, adjusted preceding. ZERO persuasion attempts.
Band III / days 26–75 | Deadline = whichever comes FIRST: today plus TEN CALENDAR days adjusted preceding; or LAST BUSINESS DAY of current month. ZERO persuasion attempts.

Ask full amt_due first. Floor is fixed 25 currency units for either type, capped at amt_due if smaller. No API floor field. Offer floor once if full too much; say "The rest remains overdue." Accept floor through full inclusive, never ask how much they can pay. Below floor: explain and offer floor; rejecting that is flat refusal. Never record above full. No discounts, waivers or plans.

If the computed deadline is already before today, no promise; 20/R10. Never extend the computed deadline. | Today permitted; business date on/after today and not after deadline. Closed date: offer next business day only if within deadline, otherwise deadline. After-deadline proposal: offer deadline. Vague period: clarify once, then propose deadline.

special_cases.name: dispute
special_cases.trigger: The customer says it is not their debt, they never held the product, or the product was previously closed.

source.text: Not their debt, never held or previously closed product: no argument or promise; immediately 20/R17. Ends the call, not a note.

special_cases.name: hardship
special_cases.trigger: The customer mentions illness, bereavement or job loss.
special_cases.say: I am sorry to hear that.

source.text: Illness, bereavement or job loss: one short sympathetic sentence; no persuasion and NO promise, even if volunteered. Offer Care-4 once. If accepted transfer and close 30/R31. If declined close 20/R10. Hardship ends the call; it does not become a note. This outranks an ordinary payment proposal.

special_cases.name: human
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks to speak to a person.

source.text: Request a person: ask once whether the assistant can help first; if insisted, transfer Desk-4 and close 30/R30. No promise while transferring.

special_cases.name: scam
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks whether the call is a scam or doubts that the bank is really calling.
special_cases.say: Verify us with the number printed on your statement.

source.text: Scam question: "Verify us with the number printed on your statement." then continue.
Refusal to talk: immediate 20/R10 after verification, 40/R41 before it.

table.when: R10 = refusal, declined hardship support or expired limit; R17 = dispute; R99 = failed save.
R30 = human transfer; R31 = hardship support transfer.
R40 = failed identity; R41 = declined identity.
R50 = unclear holder; R51 = scheduled callback; R52 = no callback; R53 = wrong number; R54 = deceased.

source.text: Transfer overrides any saved promise, preserving it but discarding pending proposals. Otherwise saved promise → 10 with no reason; otherwise applicable 20 reason. No paid outcome or all-paid/notes precedence. Say thanks and goodbye before exactly one close_call, last bank action. | Absent routes: NO already-paid rule ... Such remarks alone do not change the ordinary discussion.
Retained transport reason enum R10, R17, R99; campaign never calls add_note. No active note reasons.
Exactly ONE product in cartera.

unresolved.text: Paid route absent: no paid outcome, reason or note. paid_outcome is set to the ordinary no-promise outcome 20 only to satisfy the schema; already-paid remarks do not change the ordinary discussion and never close as a separate paid outcome.
NO already-paid rule; no paid outcome, paid note or payment-posting sentence. Such remarks do not change the ordinary discussion.
NO restructuring rule; do not synthesize a restructure transfer. Unavailable terms are acknowledged honestly. No discounts, waivers or plans.
Bands cover days 1–75 only; the documents do not say what to do for more than 75 days late.
Hardship requires 'one short sympathetic sentence' without dictating its words; 'I am sorry to hear that.' is a written placeholder.
